svg.text: Inbox and categories, appearance (theme picker), custom colour
Categories can be switched off one by one; Primary
stays. Behaviour settings state their default in the
Theme picker. Preview at the top updates live. Mode,
pure black, colour source, palette, style and contrast.
Layout and motion are the next two screens.
Wheel, hex value or a photo gives the seed. Style
chips change how colourful the scheme is.
Croft wireframes · green = primary action · wax red = destructive · amber = star and snooze · blue = read state · wax tags = behaviour notes
